m.x: Exponential ease-in/out. Produces a curve that accelerates sharply from zerousing an exponential curve in the first half, then decelerates symmetricallyto a smooth stop. The result is a pronounced S-shaped curve that starts andends slowly with a rapid transition through the midpoint. Useful for dramaticanimations where a strong snap-in and snap-out effect is desired.

p.x: The value to be eased, in the range [0, 1].

r.x: The eased value, in the range [0, 1].
